newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sanonda B shares soar to close on debut.
newsitem.headline: Sanonda B shares soar to close on debut.

text.p: The foreign currency B shares of Hubei Sanonda Co Ltd sailed to a HK$5.89 close on their debut on Thursday, compared with an issue price of HK$3.48 and despite the volatile market mood.
"Investors are keen to grab any new shares because they have the best potential for growth," an analyst at China Goutai Securities said.
Turnover in Sanonda's B shares was 15.1 million shares valued at HK$84.6 million by the close of trading.
But a second analyst warned against betting on further sharp rises for Sanonda after Thursday's gains.
"The price is by no means low compared with the company performance, I would be careful," an analyst at China Southern Securities said.
The pesticide maker's B share issue last month was 10 times over-subscribed, analysts said.
The offer carried a price/earnings ratio of 8.78 times based on forecasted 1997 net profits on a fully diluted basis under international accounting standards.
Profits after tax but before exceptional items are expected to be more than 114 million yuan in 1997, the company has said.
Sanonda, which also has A shares listed in Shenzhen, posted net profits of 77.61 million yuan in 1996 against 50.36 million yuan in 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards.
After the B share offer, the company has 281.96 million outstanding shares made up of 84.73 million state shares, 97.23 million domestic A shares and 100 million B shares, the company said.
